jobs.description: Company: Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. This role focuses on content quality, validation frameworks, and system-level validation enablement , offering deep exposure to Qualcomm SoCs through bare-metal validation content , scalable automation frameworks, and complex system debug. Engineers in this role work across HW and SW boundaries to develop, validate, and scale system-level test content , ensuring high-quality silicon validation across a wide range of SoC domains. Excellent Opportunity to work on cutting-edge SoCs & RF Chips across multiple product segments , including: Data center-class silicon Premium mobile and flagship platforms Exposure to diverse system architectures, workloads, and performance/power challenges across domain. Ability to build scalable validation solutions that extend from mobile to server-grade systems SVE Team Skill Requirements (Executive Summary) SoC/System Validation Expertise – End-to-end pre-silicon and post-silicon validation, bring-up, system integration, and silicon debug. Hardware-Software Co-Debug – Strong debugging across SoC architecture, embedded software, firmware, drivers, and hardware interfaces. Validation Content & Framework Development – Design scalable test content, automation frameworks, analysis, and debug infrastructure. Low-Level Programming – Proficiency in C/C++, Python, Assembly, Linux, device drivers, and bare-metal software development. Pre-Silicon Platforms – Experience with simulation, emulation (Veloce/FPGA), RTL understanding, and validation readiness. Knowledge of Modem, RF or SERDES high speed interfaces , clock/power management, low-power modes, and performance architecture. Performance, Power & Concurrency Analysis – System-level validation of bandwidth, latency, QoS, throughput, scalability, and power-performance tradeoffs. AI-Driven Validation – Applying AI learning/ML to improve validation/debug and log analysis productivity. AI- Driven code development – Use your coding skills to guide the AI model to create consistent high quality code for drivers, test plans , debug etc Lab & Debug Tools – Hands-on experience with JTAG, logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, kernel debuggers, and silicon debug methodologies. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Traffic and Network Modeling
jobs.description: AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) is responsible for designing, planning, delivering, and operating all of AWS's global infrastructure - in short, we keep the cloud running. Our teams include software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security professionals, operations managers, and many other essential roles. Together, we collaborate across AWS to uphold the highest standards of safety and reliability while delivering virtually unlimited capacity at the lowest possible cost. Within AIS, the Traffic and Network Modeling team develops the scientific models and software systems that guide how AWS grows and sustains one of the world's largest networks. We blend rigorous modeling techniques with modern machine learning and scalable network simulations to answer critical questions: How much network capacity is needed, and where? What should be built, and on what timeline? We're seeking an experienced Software Development Engineer to advance our network simulation platform and leverage agentic AI to automate capacity planning. In this role, you'll focus on the engineering: scaling and extending the network simulations and services that model network failures across diverse fabrics, and developing agentic AI workflows that automate troubleshooting and reduce toil. Key job responsibilities - Design, build, and deliver scalable software systems - Solve broadly defined problems by designing the right solutions, then owning them through design, implementation, deployment and operations - Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and reliability issues in production systems - Participate in architecture and design reviews, providing technical guidance to the team - Collaborate with cross-disciplinary teams and leadership to gather requirements, shape technical designs and deliver innovative products - Apply engineering best practices across the full development lifecycle - coding standards, code reviews, source control, build processes, test automation and operations - Mentor junior engineers and contribute to a strong engineering culture A day in the life You'll write and review code daily as you build the services and tools that power the team's mission. You'll dig into large-scale network simulations to find and fix performance and accuracy issues, prototype and validate solutions against production data, and build agentic AI workflows that automate troubleshooting and reduce toil. You'll partner closely with scientists and engineers on the Traffic and Network Modeling team, as well as network planning and capacity teams across AWS Infrastructure Services who depend on your systems to decide what infrastructure to build and when. You'll work in an agile, sometimes ambiguous environment, use data to make decisions, and grow alongside teammates who share your passion for the mission. About the team Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge-sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop your engineering expertise so you feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future. - 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience - 2+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience - 3+ years of building complex software systems experience - Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field - Experience programming with at least one software programming language - 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. The role will entail development of new cloud services for innovative new capabilities on Ring security devices and continuing development of the Ring infrastructure within the larger Amazon ecosystem. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Support Agent Intelligence and Evaluation
jobs.description: We are building the next generation of AI-powered advertising intelligence at Amazon Ads. Our team is developing an agent platform that gives every advertiser — regardless of size or sophistication — access to the caliber of strategic campaign management previously available only through dedicated agencies. You will work on agent orchestration, reinforcement learning from expert feedback, trust and permission systems, and scalable inference infrastructure that powers intelligent advertising decisions across Amazon's ad products. This is a greenfield opportunity to define how AI agents operate in one of the world's largest advertising ecosystems. Key job responsibilities - Develop orchestration systems that coordinate multiple specialized AI sub-agents to execute complex, multi-step advertising workflows - Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, science, partner engineering) to define integration contracts and onboard new consumers to the platform - Build identity, authorization, and permission frameworks that enforce scoped access for diverse caller types - Implement feedback signal pipelines that capture expert judgment and route it into model improvement loops - Design and operate end-to-end evaluation systems that measure recommendation quality, detect regressions, and enforce quality gates - Partner with Applied Scientists to integrate reinforcement learning from human expert feedback into production agent systems - Own system reliability, observability, and performance for always-on agent infrastructure serving thousands of concurrent advertiser accounts A day in the life You might start the morning reviewing eval results from a newly onboarded agent skill, diagnosing why routing accuracy dropped 2%. Every day is different, but the thread is the same: making AI agents smarter, safer, and more reliable at scale. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, BigMesh, Traffic Engineering
jobs.description: Want to build a Service Mesh that powers Amazon at scale? Amazon Traffic Engineering delivers managed compute and networking solutions that help engineers build secure, highly available, and scalable services — all on top of AWS technologies. We drive the foundational infrastructure, tools, and best practices behind Amazon's global SOA expansion. As an SDE on the BigMesh team, you'll build centralized traffic management and networking solutions handling security, authentication, authorization, load balancing, and routing for Amazon's most critical services. Your work will directly improve availability, efficiency, and developer productivity by turning complex SOA concerns into managed abstractions that "just work." We use Golang, Rust, and Java. If you're new to any of these, our onboarding will get you up to speed. Come help make developing software at Amazon more seamless and flexible! Key job responsibilities Own the full software development lifecycle for Service Mesh features, from design through implementation, testing, and production readiness. Write high-quality, maintainable code in Golang, Rust, or Java that meets Amazon's engineering standards. Collaborate with product managers, designers, and senior engineers to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions for traffic management and connectivity. Design and build networking features (load balancing, routing, throttling, authentication) used by thousands of Amazon services. Mentor junior engineers through code reviews, architecture discussions, and knowledge sharing. Identify and drive process improvements that increase team efficiency and system reliability. Participate in on-call rotation to resolve production issues and proactively mitigate operational risks. As part of this team, you'll be responsible for the ensuring we continue to develop better connectivity solutions for our Amazon teams and simplify/remove the hurdles the builders face as they navigate the complex networking architecture at Amazon. The team is always looking for ways to improve the engineer experience through process improvements and automation. You'll have the opportunity to contribute to these efforts and help shape the team's engineering practices. By joining this team, you'll play a critical role in delivering the core functionality that powers Amazon's internal connectivity solutions.
